parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly of a ceiling fan, made of wood. It consists of multiple blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air and create airflow in the room.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or motor housing of the ceiling fan, made of aluminum. It connects the blades to the ceiling mount and contains the motor.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the motor and provides structural support for the fan blades, enabling rotation and stability.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary while the internal motor drives the rotation of the fan blades.
